dslRule:
<!id: modernize-workingsetmodel-collection-check>
<!description: Replace direct field access to 'fAllWorkingSets' with a call to 'getAllWorkingSets()' for collection containment checks, promoting encapsulation and consistency.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: encapsulation, refactoring>

fAllWorkingSets.containsAll($listArg$)
=> getAllWorkingSets().containsAll($listArg$)
;;
summary: Replaces direct field access for collection containment checks with a public getter method for better encapsulation.
